findings.explanation: Carries generic utility/field-operations boilerplate ('move crews, budget') in an EHR clinical application response time use case.
findings.quote: Operations and risk leaders in Healthcare use signals from DIPS Arena Application Response Time to move crews, budget, and customer or regulator communications
findings.suggested_fix: Focus value on clinician productivity, reduction of EHR interaction latency during patient care, and meeting hospital response time SLAs.

summary: Specific DIPS Arena implementation details are overshadowed by templated value boilerplate and synthetic control test residue.
